key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5D00
name: walk_path_components_recursively
description: Skips through a slash-separated path string one component at a time and recurses on the remainder. It stores the recursive result in a state byte and reports success only when that value lies between 1 and 31.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5D0E
name: check_path_after_slash
description: Skips one optional leading slash, then recurses on the rest of the string and stores the returned byte in a state field. It reports failure when that byte is zero or above 31 and success otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5D20
name: check_recursive_result_range
description: Calls itself without arguments, stores the byte it returns in a state field, and reports failure when that byte is zero or above 31. Otherwise it reports success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5D3C
name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero, with no other effect. It is a stub routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5D44
name: initialise_state_and_buffer_size
description: Sets a block of state flags and counters to fixed default values and copies a global string into a state buffer. It then picks a buffer size from a stored mode byte, using a larger size for modes two to four and a smaller one otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5E10
name: handle_pause_state_update
description: While the pause flag is set it changes the task priority through exec library calls, and it then updates the paused and step flags from the stored counter. It returns the new counter value as a byte.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5E8C
name: scan_characters_using_class_table
description: Walks a byte string, testing each character against a class table, then calls a routine and returns the value it left in a local variable. A null input returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5E92
name: run_registered_handler_list
description: Walks a linked list of registered callbacks and invokes the function pointer stored in each node. It then passes its parameter to a further routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5E98
name: run_state_update_sequence
description: Runs a fixed sequence of setup calls, calling a routine with the value 100 only when a mode byte is below two. It then passes two parameters to a routine, calls another routine when that result equals one, and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5FEC
name: setup_task_and_library_mode
description: Records the current task and opens the arp library when a stored size field is small, otherwise it sets a flag in the owning structure. It converts the status bits into a mode value from zero to four and clears two state bytes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:607A
name: forward_call_without_arguments
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:6080
name: save_and_clear_pointer_field
description: Copies a field of a linked structure into a state slot, overwrites that field with an all-ones value, and sets a flag byte to one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:70A8
name: format_temp_file_name_entry
description: Passes the stored base name and a per-entry record address to a formatter that builds a temporary LZX compression file name. The record address is the index byte multiplied by a fixed record size, offset from a base pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7B74
name: clear_and_resolve_named_handle
description: Clears a 144-byte state buffer, then compares the requested name with three known names and copies the name when none match. It opens the library or file through system calls, stores the handle, or reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7BAC
name: resolve_resource_name_handle
description: Compares a name with two known names and copies it when neither matches. It then opens the resource through system calls, stores the returned handle, or reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7BC6
name: open_named_resource_handle
description: Compares a name with two known names and copies it when neither matches. It then opens the resource through system calls and stores the handle, or reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7BE0
name: open_resource_after_name_check
description: Compares a name with one known name and copies it when there is no match. It then opens the resource through system calls and stores the handle, or reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7BFA
name: open_file_and_store_handle
description: Copies the file name and access mode into a state block, then opens the file through a dos lock call. It stores the handle, or reports an unknown open mode when the mode is not recognised.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7C34
name: store_handle_or_release
description: Stores a nonzero result from a library call through a pointer. When the result is zero it makes a second library call to release the resource, then returns whether the first call succeeded.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7C4A
name: write_value_through_pointer
description: Writes its argument value through a pointer register and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7C50
name: try_open_file_handle
description: Opens a file through the dos library and stores the returned handle when the call succeeds. It returns true when the open failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7C66
name: store_data_register_through_pointer
description: Writes the value held in a data register through an address register pointer and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7C70
name: close_handle_and_clear_state
description: Closes the stored file handle when one is set, or reports an internal error when the handle is already zero. It then clears a 144-byte state block.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7C88
name: close_file_and_clear_block
description: Calls the dos close function and then writes zero into each of 144 bytes starting at the given pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7CAA
name: read_bytes_if_count_positive
description: Returns zero when the requested byte count is below one. Otherwise it calls the dos read function with the given arguments and returns its result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7CC2
name: forward_dos_read_call
description: Calls the dos read function with the arguments already in the registers and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7D28
name: forward_dos_write_call
description: Calls the dos write function with the arguments already in the registers and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:7FB0
name: fetch_standard_input_output_handles
description: Fetches the standard input handle and, unless a flag is set, the standard output handle, storing each in state fields. The output field is cleared when the flag is set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:809E
name: call_dos_routine_unless_flagged
description: Calls a dos library routine through the system base when a state flag is clear, and does nothing when the flag is set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:80C0
name: report_user_abort_and_cleanup
description: Runs a cleanup routine and then passes the fixed user-abort message text to an output routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:80D0
name: print_message_once_set_flag
description: When a flag is clear, passes a fixed text and the value five to an output routine, then sets the flag to one. It does nothing once the flag is set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:80EC
name: print_message_and_clear_flag
description: When a flag is clear, passes a fixed text and the value four to an output routine, then clears the flag to zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8106
name: write_when_output_enabled
description: Writes through the dos write function when an output-disabled flag is clear and a stored output handle is nonzero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8134
name: write_bytes_in_chunks
description: Writes a byte count to the output handle in blocks of at most one kilobyte, returning 11 if a check routine reports an error. It does nothing when output is disabled or no handle is stored.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8158
name: write_chunks_checking_between_blocks
description: Writes a count of bytes in blocks of at most one kilobyte, running a check routine before each block and returning 11 when that check fails. It returns zero once every block is written.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8164
name: write_blocks_until_count_exhausted
description: Writes the count held in a data register in blocks of one kilobyte, running a check between blocks and returning 11 if the check fails. It returns zero once the count is used up.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:818C
name: format_and_write_output_line
description: When output is enabled and a handle is stored, formats a value into a state text buffer and writes that null-terminated text through the dos write function.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:81CE
name: return_void_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:81D0
name: call_dos_routine_when_enabled
description: When a state flag is clear, calls a dos library routine through the system base. It does nothing when the flag is set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:81EE
name: call_dos_routine_when_enabled
description: When a state flag is clear, calls a dos library routine through the system base. It does nothing when the flag is set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:820C
name: read_byte_via_dos
description: Calls a routine, reads one byte through the dos read function into a stack slot, then returns that byte. Two extra routine calls run around the read when a state flag is set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8250
name: read_until_character_in_set
description: Reads and echoes characters, folding lowercase letters to uppercase when a class table marks them. It returns the first character that appears in the given set of allowed characters.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8296
name: read_key_matching_string
description: Reads and echoes characters, folding lowercase letters to uppercase, until one matches a character in the given string. It returns the matched character.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:82B2
name: read_key_from_candidate_list
description: Reads and echoes characters, folding lowercase letters to uppercase, and returns the first one that matches an entry in a candidate string. The candidate string restarts from its beginning when it runs out.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:82B6
name: return_nothing_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:82BC
name: wrap_routine_with_text_output
description: Outputs a fixed text, calls a routine, and then outputs the same text again.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:82D4
name: measure_window_space_per_item
description: Opens the intuition library, reads screen and window geometry while task switching is forbidden, and closes the library. It divides the free horizontal space by an item size and returns a minimum of eight, or 23 when a lookup fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:838C
name: string_contains_reserved_character
description: Copies an eight-character table of reserved name characters onto the stack. It returns one when any character of the given string appears in that table, and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:83C2
name: scan_string_for_table_match
description: Walks a string and checks each character against an eight-entry character table. It returns one on the first match and zero when the string ends.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:83C6
name: find_table_character_in_string
description: Advances through a string, checking each character against an eight-entry table held on the stack. It returns one on a match and zero at the end of the string.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:83CA
name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8A80
name: forward_memory_allocation_call
description: Calls the exec allocation routine through the system base with the arguments already in registers, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8AC2
name: forward_memory_free_call
description: Calls the exec memory-release routine with the arguments already in registers, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8AE0
name: allocate_with_halving_fallback
description: Stores the requested size, then calls an allocation routine, halving the size after each failure until it reaches 256 or less. It prints a fatal insufficient-memory message and returns one when no attempt succeeds.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8B00
name: retry_allocation_with_smaller_sizes
description: Halves a size value after each failed allocation attempt until it reaches 256 or less. It prints a fatal insufficient-memory message and returns one when no attempt succeeds.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8B24
name: forward_two_argument_call
description: Passes its two parameters on to another routine and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8B40
name: consume_bits_refill_buffer
description: Discards a number of bits from a bit buffer by shifting it. When the buffered bit count goes negative, it refills the buffer with the next 16-bit word from the input pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8BCA
name: read_bit_field_and_consume
description: Returns the next requested number of bits from a bit buffer, masked to that width, and then consumes those bits from the buffer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8BF8
name: decode_huffman_symbol_from_table
description: Looks up a symbol in a table indexed by the next eight bits of the bit buffer, walking a binary tree bit by bit when the entry is negative. It consumes the code length from a table and returns the decoded symbol.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8C56
name: decode_six_bit_table_symbol
description: Looks up a symbol using the next six bits of the bit buffer, walking a binary tree when the entry is negative. It consumes the bit length stored in a second table for that symbol and returns the symbol.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8CB0
name: initialise_bit_buffer_from_input
description: Reads two 16-bit words from the input pointer, advances the pointer past them, and loads them into the bit buffer with a bit count of sixteen.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8CFE
name: read_256_bytes_into_table
description: Reads 256 values through a read routine and stores each one in consecutive bytes of the destination table.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8D2E
name: read_bytes_and_sum
description: Reads bytes through a read routine into a buffer until the count runs out, and returns the running total of the bytes read.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8D60
name: read_lzx_block_header_tables
description: Reads the LZX block header by filling code length tables from the bit stream and allocating the decoding table memory. It reports insufficient memory when allocation fails, and loops forever when the sum of the table lengths does not match a 16-bit check value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8F3A
name: count_newline_characters
description: Counts the newline characters in a null-terminated string and returns the count.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8F5C
name: forward_call_with_value_one
description: Calls another routine with the value one and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8F68
name: print_text_wrapped_to_width
description: Outputs a text string line by line, breaking each line to fit the width derived from the window size and a stored margin. It prints a fixed message and stops when the check routine reports a break.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:8FF0
name: combine_four_bytes_into_word
description: Combines four bytes starting at the given address into one 16-bit value, shifting the running result left by four bits before adding each byte.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9016
name: return_void_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:901E
name: set_flag_and_call_once
description: On its first run, sets a state flag to one and calls a routine with the value zero. Later calls do nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9084
name: compare_path_base_names
description: Finds the file-name part after the last slash or colon in each of two paths, compares those parts, and returns one when they match and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:90BC
name: test_last_path_component
description: Finds the last path component of a non-empty string and calls a routine on it. It returns one when that routine returns zero and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:90E8
name: check_routine_result_is_zero
description: Calls a routine and returns one when its result is zero, and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:90FA
name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9102
name: check_path_ends_with_slash
description: Returns one when the given string is not empty and its last character is a slash, and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9126
name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9250
name: normalise_path_separators
description: Replaces every backslash in a string with a forward slash, in place, up to the terminating zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:926E
name: return_void_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9274
name: split_path_into_parts
description: Clears up to three optional output buffers, then splits a path into its device name before a colon and its directory and file parts, copying each part into the buffers that were supplied.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:92CA
name: copy_path_component_buffers
description: Copies the file-name part of a path into an output buffer, or the whole string when no separator is found. It also copies the directory and device parts into their buffers when those are supplied.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:92E2
name: copy_path_name_and_volume
description: Copies the file-name part of a path into an output buffer, then copies the directory and device parts into their buffers when those are supplied. It zero-terminates each copied part.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9312
name: copy_path_directory_and_device
description: Copies the directory part of a path and its device part into their output buffers when those buffers are supplied. It zero-terminates each copy.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:933E
name: copy_device_part_when_present
description: Zero-terminates the directory output buffer and, when a device separator is present, copies the device part into its buffer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9400
name: find_entry_by_name
description: Walks a linked list of named entries and returns the first entry whose name matches the given text. Depending on option bits it compares a split copy of the name, and it can check a break condition between entries.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9424
name: scan_named_entry_list
description: Scans a linked list of named entries from its head pointer and returns the first entry that matches the target name. When the option bit is set it compares a transformed copy of the name, and it stops early when a break check fires.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:942E
name: find_first_matching_list_entry
description: Walks a linked list of entries and returns the first one that the comparison routine accepts. A break check runs between entries when its option is set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:94A6
name: search_entries_with_transform
description: Checks each list entry against a comparison routine, optionally comparing a transformed copy of the name, and returns the first entry that matches. It returns zero when the list is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:94BC
name: scan_entries_with_break_check
description: Repeatedly checks for a break through the dos library, then walks a list of entries and returns the first one that matches. It returns zero when no entry matches.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:94EA
name: walk_entries_for_match
description: Walks a list of entries, skipping those that fail a break-checked comparison, and returns the first entry the comparison accepts. It returns zero at the end of the list.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:94F2
name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9590
name: append_named_list_entry
description: Optionally rejects duplicate names, allocates a new list entry sized for the name, copies the name into it, and appends it to the list tail. It returns the new entry, or zero with a status of one when allocation fails or two for a duplicate.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:95D4
name: append_unique_named_entry
description: Rejects a name already present in the list, then allocates an entry sized for the name, copies the name in, and appends it. It returns the new entry, or zero with a status of one on allocation failure and two on a duplicate.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:95DE
name: allocate_and_append_named_entry
description: Allocates a list entry sized for the name, copies the name into it, and appends it to the list tail. It returns the entry, or zero with a status of one when allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:9606
name: initialise_and_append_entry
description: Clears a 20-byte entry record, copies the name into it, marks it as used, and appends it to the list tail. It returns the entry and sets the status to zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:963A
name: link_entry_at_list_tail
description: Links a new entry onto the tail of a list. When the list has no tail it reports an internal list error and sets the status to one, returning zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:966C
name: link_entry_at_tail_unchecked
description: Links a new entry onto the tail of a list and sets the status to zero without checking the tail.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B2A0
name: open_output_file_or_report
description: Opens the output file named in the state block through a routine. When the open fails it reports that the output file cannot be opened, and it returns true on failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B324
name: release_output_file_if_open
description: Releases the file stored in an output-file field when that field is set, and does nothing otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B524
name: allocate_lzx_working_buffers
description: Allocates the LZX working buffers, with sizes derived from state values, and stores each pointer in the state block. On any allocation failure it reports an error and returns one; on success it sets a ready flag and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B544
name: allocate_lzx_secondary_buffers
description: Allocates the remaining LZX working buffers, with sizes derived from state values, and stores each pointer. It returns one when any allocation fails, otherwise it sets the ready flag and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B560
name: allocate_lzx_buffers_second_window
description: Allocates the LZX working buffers from the second window buffer onward, storing each pointer in the state block. It returns one when any allocation fails, otherwise it sets the ready flag and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B57C
name: allocate_lzx_buffers_from_table
description: Allocates the LZX working buffers from the table buffer onward, storing each pointer in the state block. It returns one when any allocation fails, otherwise it sets the ready flag and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B59E
name: allocate_lzx_buffers_after_table
description: Allocates the remaining LZX buffers after the table buffer, recording the stream pointer and storing each allocated pointer. It returns one when an allocation fails, otherwise it sets the ready flag and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B5BE
name: allocate_lzx_buffers_second_block
description: Allocates the LZX buffers from the second fixed-size block onward, storing each pointer. It returns one when an allocation fails, otherwise it sets the ready flag and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B5D8
name: allocate_lzx_small_block
description: Allocates the last small LZX block, then sets up the lookup tables and the ready flag. It returns one when the allocation or table setup fails and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B5F0
name: finish_lzx_buffer_setup_checked
description: Sets up the lookup tables for the LZX buffers and, when that succeeds, stores the output pointers and sets the ready flag. It returns zero on success and one when the table setup fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B60A
name: finish_lzx_buffer_setup
description: Stores the output pointers into the state block, sets the lookup tables, and sets the ready flag. It returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B638
name: free_lzx_working_buffers
description: Releases each LZX working buffer that is currently allocated, clearing its stored pointer. It then clears the ready flag.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B762
name: free_lzx_pending_buffer
description: Releases the buffer held in a pending slot when one is stored, passing the recorded size, and then clears the slot.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B77A
name: flush_lzx_pending_output
description: Writes out any bytes between the pending output position and the stored end position. It reports a failure through an error routine when the write fails, then records the new end position.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B89E
name: write_block_to_output_buffer
description: Writes the requested number of bytes to the output through a buffer routine and adds that count to a running total. It returns zero on success, two on a short write, and one when the early check reports a stop.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B8A4
name: report_error_code_one
description: Passes the error code one, together with an error-state pointer, to an error routine and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B8B4
name: allocate_lzx_pointer_block
description: Allocates one block of working memory and, when that succeeds, stores three pointers into it at fixed offsets. It returns true when the allocation failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B8CA
name: reset_lzx_pointer_block
description: Recomputes the three pointers into the existing working block from its stored base address and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:B8E6
name: free_lzx_pointer_block
description: Releases the working block when it is allocated and clears its stored address.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:BCAC
name: build_lzx_length_lookup_table
description: On its first run, fills a 512-entry lookup table with values that rise in doubling runs and sets a done flag. Later calls do nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:BCF4
name: fill_lookup_runs_after_first
description: Fills the remaining lookup entries in doubling runs, writing a raised value first and then the base value, until the table is full.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:BD14
name: fill_lookup_runs_from_start
description: Fills the remaining lookup entries in doubling runs, starting each run with a raised value and then the base value, until the table is full.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:C596
name: allocate_zeroed_tree_tables
description: Allocates a block sized from a count, zeroes it, and stores four pointers into it at offsets derived from that count. It returns one when the allocation fails and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:C5BC
name: reset_zeroed_tree_tables
description: Zeroes an existing block of the given size and stores the same four pointers into it. It returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:C5C8
name: fill_block_and_set_pointers
description: Fills a block with a byte value for the given count, then stores four pointers into it at offsets derived from a size value. It returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:C606
name: free_zeroed_tree_tables
description: Releases the block behind the first pointer when it is set, passing the size derived from the count, then clears all four pointers.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:C874
name: forward_formatted_output_call
description: Calls the exec formatting routine through the system base with the arguments already in registers, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:C898
name: forward_formatted_output_call
description: Calls the exec formatting routine through the system base with the arguments already in registers, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:C8BE
name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of a data register to the memory address held in an address register.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:D544
name: update_crc32_checksum
description: Updates a running CRC-32 checksum over a byte block using a 256-entry table in the state block. It stores the running value and returns its bitwise complement.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:D63E
name: checksum_in_megabyte_blocks
description: When no data is given, sets the running checksum to all ones. Otherwise it processes the byte count in blocks of one megabyte through a checksum routine and returns its result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:D65A
name: process_remaining_megabyte_blocks
description: Splits a byte count into blocks of one megabyte, calling a routine for each full block and once more for the remainder. It returns when the count is used up.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:D66C
name: process_megabyte_blocks_until_done
description: Calls a routine for each full megabyte block of a count, subtracting the block size each time, and then calls it once more for any leftover bytes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E420
name: build_canonical_huffman_table
description: Counts how often each code length appears in a byte array, derives the first code for each length, and fills a decoding table with the resulting entries. It writes a repeating pattern of constants into the table.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E6C0
name: run_handler_table_entries
description: Walks a null-terminated table of handler pointers, calling each entry while the done flag is clear or no result exists yet. It then sets the done flag and returns the last result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E6C6
name: run_handler_table_sequence
description: Runs through a null-terminated table of handler pointers, calling each handler and keeping the last result. It then sets the done flag and returns that result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E6F4
name: call_indirect_handler_return_constant
description: Calls a handler through a function pointer held in a global variable, passing the address of a global variable, then returns twenty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E716
name: invoke_global_callback
description: Calls a function pointer stored in a global table with the address of a global variable as its argument, then returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E7D8
name: compare_case_insensitive_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated byte strings character by character, folding lowercase letters to uppercase. It returns the difference at the first mismatch, or zero when the strings are equal.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E81C
name: parse_signed_integer
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign and then the decimal digits of a string, stores the signed value through a pointer, and returns the offset of the first character after the number.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E868
name: lowercase_flagged_characters_in_place
description: Converts each character in a zero-terminated string that a class table flags as uppercase to lowercase, in place, and returns the string pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E874
name: lowercase_flagged_tail_in_place
description: Converts characters from a given pointer to the end of a zero-terminated string to lowercase where a class table flags them, in place, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E88E
name: copy_string_with_case_table
description: Stores a byte into a string buffer and then writes each following character, lowercasing those a class table flags, until the terminating zero is reached.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E8A0
name: uppercase_flagged_characters_in_place
description: Converts each character in a zero-terminated string that a class table flags as lowercase to uppercase, in place, and returns the string pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E8AC
name: uppercase_flagged_tail_in_place
description: Converts characters from a given pointer to the end of a zero-terminated string to uppercase where a class table flags them, in place, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E8C6
name: copy_string_uppercase_flagged
description: Stores a byte into a string buffer and then writes each following character, uppercased where a class table flags it, until the terminating zero is reached.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E8D8
name: drain_and_free_queue
description: Pops each node from a pending list, stores its next pointer and data, runs a flush routine when the list ends, and frees each node's memory.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E8DE
name: drain_pending_list_entries
description: Repeatedly pops nodes from a pending list, stores the next pointer, optionally runs a flush routine, and frees each node until the list is empty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E948
name: dispatch_message_with_hooks
description: Records a value in a message frame, runs an optional hook, then either calls a cleanup routine or runs an exec library sequence to reply and release the message. It returns the stored value as a 64-bit result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:E950
name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Splits a command line into arguments, honouring quoted strings and asterisk escapes for escape and newline characters. It counts the arguments, allocates a pointer table for them, fills that table, and then runs the registered hooks.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EAB4
name: free_block_if_allocated
description: Releases a stored memory block when a counter and a pointer are both set, and returns the counter value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EAD8
name: compare_strings_up_to_length
description: Compares up to a given number of characters of two strings. It returns minus one or one at the first difference, depending on which character is smaller, and zero when the strings match over that length.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EAFC
name: return_comparison_sign
description: Returns minus one when the preceding comparison shows the first value is less than or equal to the second, and one otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EB08
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the terminating zero of a destination buffer, copies the source string from there including its terminator, and returns the original destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EB20
name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies up to a given count of characters from a source string into a buffer, stopping after the terminating zero, then zero-fills the rest of the count. It returns the buffer pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EB30
name: copy_string_pad_remainder
description: Copies a zero-terminated string into a buffer of a given length and zero-fills whatever space remains. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EB3A
name: zero_fill_memory_block
description: Writes zero into every byte of a block, covering the given count plus one byte, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EB44
name: scan_flagged_characters_then_call
description: Scans characters of a string through a class-table flag, then calls a routine and returns a local value it leaves behind. A null input returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EB78
name: run_handler_list_then_forward
description: Calls every handler in the global handler list, then passes its parameter on to another routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EB7C
name: run_handler_list_then_finish
description: Calls every handler in the global handler list in turn, then makes one further call with no arguments.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EBC6
name: save_context_and_drain_queue
description: Saves a block of context values onto a stack area, then pops queued nodes one at a time, calling a scheduling routine and freeing each node until the queue empties. It returns the saved value pair.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:EC50
name: forward_call_without_arguments
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:0000
name: start_program_entry_point
description: Program entry point that allocates a working copy of the global data block, relocates it, and rebuilds the command-line arguments inside it. It then runs the main routine on that copy and releases it before returning.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:020C
name: clean_up_process_resources
description: Runs an optional cleanup hook, then either releases a stored memory block or unlocks, closes and replies to the outstanding resources. It finishes by releasing the working memory and returns the stored result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:02A8
name: invoke_global_callback
description: Calls a function pointer stored in a global table with the address of a global variable as its argument, then returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:02AE
name: call_indirect_handler_return_constant
description: Calls a handler through a function pointer held in a global variable, passing the address of a global variable, then returns twenty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:02B4
name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Splits a command line into arguments, honouring quoted strings and asterisk escapes for escape and newline characters. It counts the arguments, allocates a pointer table for them, fills that table, and then runs the registered hooks.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:02BC
name: open_named_input_stream
description: Initialises a name buffer and opens the named input through a routine. On success it sets an input-ready flag, and on failure it reports the name through an output routine and returns true.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:02FA
name: set_input_ready_flag
description: Sets the input-ready flag in the state block and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:0818
name: transfer_block_through_buffer
description: Passes a block through a buffer routine and adds the byte count to a running total on a full transfer. It returns zero on success, two on a short transfer, or one when the early check reports a stop.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:0836
name: transfer_count_through_buffer
description: Transfers the count held in a data register through the buffer routine, adds it to a running total when the whole count moves, and returns two on a short transfer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:084E
name: add_count_to_running_total
description: Adds the count held in a data register to a running total in the state block and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:142E
name: free_linked_node_list
description: Walks a linked list, releasing each node through a memory routine with a fixed size of 118 bytes, then clears the head and tail pointers and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:144C
name: clear_linked_list_head_tail
description: Sets the head and tail pointers of a linked list to zero without freeing its nodes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:162C
name: pack_flag_bits_into_byte
description: Combines eight state flags into one byte, setting each bit whose flag is nonzero, and stores the result through the pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:51C8
name: parse_lzx_option_switches
description: Parses command-line option letters one at a time through a switch, setting the matching state fields from each option's value, and reports an error for an unknown option.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5B7C
name: fetch_next_command_option
description: Scans the command-line argument array for the next option, recording the option letter and the first argument it skips past. It returns the text that follows the option letter, or zero when no argument remains.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5B82
name: fetch_next_command_option
description: Scans the command-line argument array for the next option, recording the option letter and the first argument it skips past. It returns the text that follows the option letter, or zero when no argument remains.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5C24
name: next_positional_argument
description: Returns the next command-line argument that is not an option, treating a double-dash marker as the end of options, or zero when no arguments remain.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5C8E
name: parse_date_string_fields
description: Parses a date written as year, month and day separated by slashes. The year must fall between nineteen seventy and twenty ninety-nine and is stored in a compact one-byte form, the month must be 1 to 12 and the day 1 to 31. It returns zero when all fields are valid and one otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5CBA
name: store_prefix_and_parse_date
description: Stores a given prefix byte in a date record, then parses a month of 1 to 12 and a day of 1 to 31 from a slash-separated string. It returns one when either field is out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5CD2
name: parse_month_and_day_fields
description: Parses a month of 1 to 12 and a day of 1 to 31 from a slash-separated string, storing them in a date record. It returns one when either field is out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5CE4
name: store_month_and_parse_day
description: Reads a month value through a routine and stores it, then parses a day of 1 to 31 from a slash-separated string and stores it. It returns one when either field is out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5D00
name: walk_path_components_recursively
description: Skips through a slash-separated path string one component at a time and recurses on the remainder. It stores the recursive result in a state byte and reports success only when that value lies between 1 and 31.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5D0E
name: check_path_after_slash
description: Skips one optional leading slash, then recurses on the rest of the string and stores the returned byte in a state field. It reports failure when that byte is zero or above 31 and success otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5D20
name: check_recursive_result_range
description: Calls itself without arguments, stores the byte it returns in a state field, and reports failure when that byte is zero or above 31. Otherwise it reports success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5D3C
name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero, with no other effect. It is a stub routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5D44
name: initialise_state_and_buffer_size
description: Sets a block of state flags and counters to fixed default values and copies a global string into a state buffer. It then picks a buffer size from a stored mode byte, using a larger size for modes two to four and a smaller one otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5E10
name: handle_pause_state_update
description: While the pause flag is set it changes the task priority through exec library calls, and it then updates the paused and step flags from the stored counter. It returns the new counter value as a byte.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5E8C
name: scan_characters_using_class_table
description: Walks a byte string, testing each character against a class table, then calls a routine and returns the value it left in a local variable. A null input returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5E92
name: run_registered_handler_list
description: Walks a linked list of registered callbacks and invokes the function pointer stored in each node. It then passes its parameter to a further routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5E98
name: run_state_update_sequence
description: Runs a fixed sequence of setup calls, calling a routine with the value 100 only when a mode byte is below two. It then passes two parameters to a routine, calls another routine when that result equals one, and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:5FEC
name: setup_task_and_library_mode
description: Records the current task and opens the arp library when a stored size field is small, otherwise it sets a flag in the owning structure. It converts the status bits into a mode value from zero to four and clears two state bytes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:607A
name: forward_call_without_arguments
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:6080
name: save_and_clear_pointer_field
description: Copies a field of a linked structure into a state slot, overwrites that field with an all-ones value, and sets a flag byte to one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:70A8
name: format_temp_file_name_entry
description: Passes the stored base name and a per-entry record address to a formatter that builds a temporary LZX compression file name. The record address is the index byte multiplied by a fixed record size, offset from a base pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7B74
name: clear_and_resolve_named_handle
description: Clears a 144-byte state buffer, then compares the requested name with three known names and copies the name when none match. It opens the library or file through system calls, stores the handle, or reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7BAC
name: resolve_resource_name_handle
description: Compares a name with two known names and copies it when neither matches. It then opens the resource through system calls, stores the returned handle, or reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7BC6
name: open_named_resource_handle
description: Compares a name with two known names and copies it when neither matches. It then opens the resource through system calls and stores the handle, or reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7BE0
name: open_resource_after_name_check
description: Compares a name with one known name and copies it when there is no match. It then opens the resource through system calls and stores the handle, or reports failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7BFA
name: open_file_and_store_handle
description: Copies the file name and access mode into a state block, then opens the file through a dos lock call. It stores the handle, or reports an unknown open mode when the mode is not recognised.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7C34
name: store_handle_or_release
description: Stores a nonzero result from a library call through a pointer. When the result is zero it makes a second library call to release the resource, then returns whether the first call succeeded.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7C4A
name: write_value_through_pointer
description: Writes its argument value through a pointer register and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7C50
name: try_open_file_handle
description: Opens a file through the dos library and stores the returned handle when the call succeeds. It returns true when the open failed.
